layouts.name: Explorer
layouts.description: A file-manager structure: case and files on the left, a report directory in the middle, and a large preview on the right. Totals and mapping have their own review view.
layouts.structure: Intake rail / report directory / preview canvas

layouts.name: Guided Workflow
layouts.description: A step-by-step workspace with separate screens for case setup, data review, mapping and export. Move through the flow using Back and Continue, or jump between steps.
layouts.structure: Step navigation / single task screen / next action

layouts.name: Conversion Board
layouts.description: Three workflow columns keep Intake, Inspect and Deliver in view together. Select a report to open its full-width canvas beneath the board.
layouts.structure: Three workflow columns / expandable report canvas

layouts.name: Focus Workspace
layouts.description: The report table owns the screen. File setup, report selection, totals and mapping open in a side panel from the toolbar, leaving the data front and center.
layouts.structure: Command toolbar / full-screen table / tool drawer

layouts.name: Case File
layouts.description: A conversion record arranged like a working document. A contents margin jumps to each section, while a delivery desk keeps mapping and export alongside the file.
layouts.structure: Contents margin / conversion document / delivery desk
